_readme: Source-of-truth sheets for 'Gordon in Black Ops III Zombies'. null = unfilled/unverified cell (must be resolved against the real installed games before building). Values marked from HL2 defaults are reference only until verified in the player's HL2 files.

project.tagline_draft: Survive Black Ops III Zombies as Gordon, crowbar in hand and the full Half-Life 2 arsenal on the walls.
project.description_draft: Play Black Ops III Zombies as Gordon Freeman. Start with the crowbar, earn points, and buy Half-Life 2 weapons off the wall, gravity gun included. Co-op for up to 4 players, everyone as Gordon. Needs your own copies of Black Ops III and Half-Life 2; HL2's sounds and models are read from your install.

games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops III

rows: HL2 pain/death/hurt sounds (Gordon is silent: use suit voice + damage sounds)
HEV suit chatter on low health / downed
Read HL2 VPK/MDL/VTF/WAV from {game:half-life-2} at runtime, convert to BO3 formats on first launch into a local cache (nothing from HL2 ships in the upload)
Register HL2 weapons as BO3 Zombies weapons
Wall-buy chalk positions and costs on one Zombies map
Force every player model/viewmodel to Gordon
Pull/throw physics objects or zombies (approximation in BO3)
2-4 player Zombies lobby, join via Melty link
Write host address to a log line for recipe.multiplayer.connect.address

games.game: Call of Duty: Black Ops III

recipe_draft.note: BO3 has no Melty loader config. Inspect the install to choose mod folders/executable. Do not set connect until hosting and joining are tested with two running copies.
